limitations: Qualified Chromium 143.0.7499.4 / Playwright 1.57.0 on Ubuntu 24.04 CI; no cross-browser or physical-device claim.

Real local index, bundled SDK, application modules and IndexedDB; deterministic synthetic HTTP/Phoenix and native fault boundaries. No production backend, RLS/Auth, real-user or multi-device qualification.
Service Workers blocked; unchanged local static files supply the explicitly declared offline shell. Production Service Worker installation/caching is not qualified.
Resource conclusion covers the observed classes across 54 completed transitions after 9 warmup transitions; it is not an unlimited-lifetime or general heap-leak claim.
WebSocket observer preserves the routed pre-observer API/prototype/instanceof/constants but changes constructor identity; observer and Playwright WebSocket routing are identical in all A/B variants.
H1 reproduced in the current controlled A/B0/B1 experiment. The missing first pageerror from the historical f00f253 run was not recovered.
Historical safety refusal and pending specialist review are preserved. Current normal source writes succeeded; no historical policy-clearance decision is claimed.
Local macOS Chromium startup later timed out; executable final evidence comes from the normal isolated CI environment. Earlier failed/incomplete/unqualified attempts retain their original outcomes.

GitHub artifact retention is 14 days; the original ZIP is also supplied as a local deliverable. Package binary hashes are not recorded; pinned versions, source hashes and execution environment are recorded.

Normal 1B cases use bounded runner process cleanup; the intentional timeout probe additionally retains explicit parent/child PID verification. Final CI observes zero browser/driver processes.

observations: All nine browser processes ended ERROR before behavioral checks; checks=[] in every result.
#email exists in the DOM but remained hidden; fill timed out after 8000 ms.
Capture then failed because App.state referenced missing PablicusDebug.
__integration.releaseWrite() ran before App.state and did not produce the recorded capture_error, so the instrument global was present far enough for releaseWrite.
No final PNG or HTML was retained by the nine cases because one shared capture try stopped after App.state failed.
Initial probe without instrument reached real UI login, user A, conversation c1, active list=1 and empty vault before an unmodeled get_message_actions response blocked Canvas.

confirmed_harness_defects.finding: instrument.js stores native timer/rAF functions as properties of object native and later invokes them as native.setTimeout/native.clearTimeout/native.setInterval/native.clearInterval/native.raf/native.caf, changing their receiver from window to native.
confirmed_harness_defects.evidence: Static source plus independent Node VM probe in review R1: all six receiver_is_window values change from true to false.

confirmed_harness_defects.finding: case.py final capture uses one sequential try: releaseWrite -> App.state -> instrument snapshot -> screenshot -> HTML. Missing PablicusDebug in App.state prevents all later capture. There is no independent pageerror collector in case.py.
confirmed_harness_defects.evidence: case.py source and absence of PNG/HTML in the original latest artifact.

confirmed_harness_defects.finding: LocalBoundary already models get_message_actions/get_pinned_messages/factory_list_projects, but these branches occur before base host/auth logging. They match path suffixes, do not enforce method/host/auth context, do not enter Boundary.calls, and factory_list_projects does not honor offline.
confirmed_harness_defects.evidence: case.py/network.py static analysis; prior probe confirms real caller is POST /rest/v1/rpc/get_message_actions for user A.

hypotheses.statement: A receiver-sensitive native call introduced by the instrument may be the first browser exception.
hypotheses.support: Before app.js can unhide #legacyLogin at line 275, it creates ChatCanvas at line 108; ChatCanvas.create calls reset(), which calls window.clearTimeout at chat-canvas.js line 1140. The instrumented clearTimeout forwards as native.clearTimeout(id) with receiver native. If Chromium rejects that receiver, the observed hidden login and missing PablicusDebug are explained.

hypotheses.statement: Another early exception before app.js line 275 may be responsible.
hypotheses.status: OPEN because the first page error and console stack were not retained.

not_product_defects: The nine ERROR results are not nine Pablicus defects.
Missing PablicusDebug is a secondary observation, not established root cause.
The previously missing get_message_actions model is already present in LocalBoundary; it should not be re-added.

collector: Attach pageerror, console and requestfailed listeners before page.goto and keep them independent of application globals.
Capture response failures for declared local/synthetic boundary without logging secrets.
Capture safe DOM/global state, instrument snapshot, screenshot and HTML in independent try blocks.
Use typeof/optional access; do not fabricate PablicusDebug.
An artificial early failure must retain primary error plus nonzero result and still save screenshot/HTML where the browser permits.
instrument: Preserve native receiver/this when calling saved browser primitives.
Do not disable resource observation or alter standard API semantics just to pass counters.
network: Keep existing special RPC responses but constrain them to exact API host, POST method, exact /rest/v1/rpc/<name> path, authenticated synthetic user and expected context.
Log special responses into the same boundary journal and honor offline for every special route.
Leave unknown requests as explicit 501/blocked evidence; never add a universal empty-success fallback.
